scopeLimits: Most unresolved municipalities received homepage discovery only; those have not received a full historical-publication sweep.
Only specifically listed PDF pages/logo occurrences were inspected except the Armstrong scanned guide, which was checked all9 pages.
HTTP403/404/406, timeouts and download-size limits are access/inspection gaps, not proof artwork is raster or absent.
Native variants for Nakusp and Radium do not resolve the existing horizontal-colour/current-layout website designs.
No messages or master-file requests were sent to municipalities or designers.

Fresh municipal coverage includes96 homepage attempts plus separate actual searches for Fort St James, Okanagan Falls and shishalh district. Most homepage-only subjects did not receive deeper historical publication inspection.

Final targeted follow-up covered Daajing Giids plus four schools, with all35 pages of three school PDFs inspected. QSD69 candidate is an agency SVG; Daajing case-study visuals are JPEG/MP4, no native village download.
Root college/university extraction QA is a separate review of59 supplied assets and is not counted as municipal fresh source-search coverage.
No native master files were requested by email or other messages. A blocked source or no vector in inspected occurrences is not proof that no native master exists elsewhere.
